usage: Components and pages use semantic tokens only (--color-page, --color-primary-foreground, --space-4, --text-body-size ...).
Never use --primitive-* tokens or hardcoded colors, sizes or fonts.
Light/dark is switched by data-theme="light|dark" on <html>; without it the OS preference applies.
Text styles are sets of variables named --text-<style>-<size|line|weight|tracking|style|family>.

tokens.name: color.page
tokens.description: The page itself. Everything sits on it.

tokens.description: App chrome around the content: header, sidebar, footer.

tokens.name: color.container
tokens.description: A region that groups several cards, like a settings section or a table wrapper.

tokens.name: color.card
tokens.description: Content blocks on the page: cards, panels, table rows.

tokens.name: color.sunken

tokens.name: color.standout

tokens.name: color.on-standout-secondary-foreground

tokens.name: shadow.border
tokens.description: A 1px outline drawn as a shadow. Use it instead of a border on cards, inputs and anything at rest, so the edge needs no extra layout space.

tokens.name: shadow.large

tokens.name: shadow.extra-large
